about_the_game:
• Co-op - team up with up to 6 players or take risks alone.

  • Skills - unlock an extensive list of skills and form unique combinations that can turn the tide of battle.

  • Class System - Choose your favourite class, combine abilities and find your unique fighting style.

  • Artifacts - destroy enemies, earn soul coin and exchange them for various equipment.

  • Epic bosses - after a few waves you'll face a big fight that will test how well prepared you are.

  • Arena events - unexpected situations that can turn a familiar arena into a living hell or give you a tactical advantage.

  • Pets - summon your faithful assistants to efficiently collect essence.

Will you be able to overcome all the challenges and defeat the final boss? Try your hand at Life Souls and gain the power to stand where no one else could.

content_descriptors.notes: Life Souls contains intense violence, blood and gore.

name: Life Souls
short_description: Life Souls is a co-op Roguelike Action-RPG in which you pump ancient souls while fighting for survival in the bodies of fallen guardians. Choose a class, unlock skills and fight waves of enemies to reach epic bosses and emerge victorious.
